description: Change an existing TASK — what the SimplifyQA editor does, then it READS THE TASK BACK and reports each change. Pass `taskId` (id, code like TA-3, or exact name) and only what to change: `plannedStartDate` / `plannedEndDate` (YYYY-MM-DD), `assignee` (email, name, user id or "me" — one that matches nobody is refused) or `unassign:true`, `state`, `priority` (the project's own values; an unknown one is refused with the valid ones listed), `releaseId` / `sprintId` (id, code or name; a sprint brings its release; "none" clears), `storyId` (the linked user story; "none" clears), `name`, `description`, `estimatedEffort`, `actualEffort`, `remainingEffort`. Needs the add_task privilege. A start date after the end date is refused — move the end date too.

assignee.description: Who to assign it to: email (rohini.k@simplify3x.com), name, numeric user id, or "me".

releaseId.description: Release: id, code (RE-44) or exact name; "none" clears it (and the sprint).

sprintId.description: Sprint: id, code (SP-1) or exact name; it must belong to the task's release. "none" clears it.

storyId.description: Linked user story: id or key (US_123); "none" unlinks it.

taskId.description: Task id, code (TA-3) or exact name.

name: task_update
title: Update a task (planned dates, assignee, state, …)
